discovery.title: Researchers made a tiny, lightning-like glowing sphere in a lab
discovery.summary: A new experiment produced a short-lived glowing structure that researchers say may offer a controlled way to study soliton physics and the long-standing mystery of ball lightning.
discovery.why_it_matters: A repeatable laboratory setup could help separate what scientists can reproduce from what eyewitness reports describe in nature.
